notes.summary: Data Interpretation gives a table or chart and 3–5 questions on it. 2–4 questions in Tier 1 and 3–5 in Tier 2. Read the units and the title before calculating.

concepts.title: Reading the data
concepts.body: Check the units (thousands, lakhs, %), the years and the labels. Write the needed values down before calculating.

concepts.title: Percentage change
concepts.body: % change = (New − Old)/Old × 100. The base is always the earlier (or “compared to”) value.

concepts.title: Ratio and average
concepts.body: Ratio: write both values and cancel common factors. Average: total ÷ number of items.

varieties.name: Average from data
varieties.how: Add the required values and divide by their count.

varieties.name: Ratio
varieties.how: Write the two quantities and reduce by their HCF.

tips: Approximate when options are far apart.
traps: % increase from A to B uses A as the base; % decrease from B to A uses B.
Do not mix totals of different years or units.

passages.title: Production of Company X
passages.text: Study the bar chart and answer the questions. The chart shows the production of Company X (in thousand units) from 2019 to 2023: 2019 – 40, 2020 – 55, 2021 – 50, 2022 – 70, 2023 – 85.

passages.title: Sales of four shops
passages.text:
Study the table and answer the questions. Sales of four shops (in ₹ lakh):
Shop20222023
A120150
B80100
C150135
D100140

questions.q: What is the average annual production of Company X from 2019 to 2023 (in thousand units)?
What is the ratio of the sales of shop A to the sales of shop B in 2023?
By what percent did the production of Company X increase from 2021 to 2022?
What is the average sales per shop in 2022 (in ₹ lakh)?
What is the ratio of the total production in 2019 and 2020 together to the total production in 2022 and 2023 together?
By what percent did the total sales of all four shops increase from 2022 to 2023?
